_comment: Copy to entra-automation.json. Identity used for unattended Microsoft Graph access by bootstrap_entra_objects.py. Holds NO secret: the private key is in the file named by key_file (mode 600, never commit it). Example values are masked values from the reference lab; see README.md for each.
_tenant_id: <TENANT_ID> — Directory (tenant) ID. Entra admin center > Overview
_tenant_domain: <TENANT_DOMAIN> — the tenant's verified domain used for test-user UPNs
_client_id: <AUTOMATION_CLIENT_ID> — Application (client) ID of the automation app registration
_key_file: <AUTOMATION_KEY_FILE> — PEM private key, path relative to this file
_cert_thumbprint_sha1: <AUTOMATION_CERT_THUMBPRINT> — SHA-1 thumbprint (40 hex) of the certificate uploaded to the app: Certificates & secrets > Certificates
_graph_app_roles: Microsoft Graph APPLICATION permissions the automation app needs, with admin consent granted
